newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $104/dressed, passed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $104/dressed, passed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle were bid $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis amid fairly active packer inquiry, but bids were passed by owners pricing cattle at $106.00, market sources said.
"I don't think there will be anything happening unless packers come around with higher money," one source said.
Cattle traded last week at $104.00, with a few at $104.50 in active voluem.
Asking prices on a live basis were at $66.00, but no bids were reported. This week's showlist was estimated near last week's level of 66,000 head, they said.
